text: I'm a foster parent, I've had him just over a week. He's 3 months old and his temperature is 38.7, I've taken it twice. One of his eyes is pink and sticky with gunk in the corner. His colour is normal, lips look normal pink, and he's moving his head fine, he can look down at his tummy. I'm really scared, I don't know what's normal for him yet and I don't want to get this wrong.
